title: Paging through bytes
description:
Show a large block of your own program's memory one page at a time, like a memory viewer.

```
page 1 of 16 (256 bytes per page)
00000000  48 65 6c 6c 6f 00 00 00 ...  Hello...
next page, previous page, jump to offset 0x400
```
hints: Reuse a hex-row formatter: offset, 16 bytes, then the printable characters.
requirements: The data is a buffer your program owns.
`page(n)` returns 16 rows of 16 bytes; out-of-range pages are refused.
Jumping to an offset shows the page that contains it and highlights the byte.
stretch: Search for a byte pattern and jump to each match.
